31792-B.s: The bill amends the 2008 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) by adjusting expenditure and revenue lines and fixing the commitment amount for general and supplementary grants under the Financial Relations Act at EUR 14,828,818,000. It takes effect from 1 June 2008 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The budget of expenditure and revenue of the municipal fund for 2008 is amended, as shown in the budget statement attached to this law.
De begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2008 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat.

31924-E.s: This slotwet (final budget act) amends the 2008 budget statement of the Spaarfonds AOW, the state savings fund for the old-age pension, by adjusting the expenditure and revenue figures to the realised outturn. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and makes the act take effect the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.

31965-XVII.s: The bill amends the 2009 budget statement for the Youth and Family ministry (XVII) in line with the spring memorandum, mainly raising spending on youth care and child protection investigations. It sets the amendment's effective date as 1 June 2009 and provides for retroactive effect if published later.
q: These funds are mainly intended to absorb autonomous growth resulting from growth elsewhere in the youth chain.
Deze middelen zijn voornamelijk bestemd voor het opvangen van autonome groei als gevolg van groei elders in de jeugdketen.

32395-B.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), raising the commitment amounts for the general grant and the integration and decentralisation grants. It also records a long list of budget mutations and transfers to municipalities for specific policy tasks such as youth care, inburgering and supervision of licensing laws.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget of expenditure and receipts of the municipal fund for the year 2010
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2010

32565-C.s: The bill amends the 2010 budget of the provincial fund (provinciefonds), setting revised commitment amounts for general and integration/decentralisation grants and adjusting expenditure and revenue lines. It takes effect on 1 December 2010, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: We ... have found and resolved ... that the need has arisen to amend the budget of expenditures and receipts of the provincial fund for the year 2010
Wij ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2010

33090-I.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget statement of the Royal Household (begroting van de Koning), raising the spending figures by a supplementary amount to reflect the Najaarsnota adjustments. It sets the budget figures in thousands of euros and fixes the entry into force as 1 December 2011, with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: is amended, as shown in the corresponding budget statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33280-H.s: The bill amends the 2012 budget statement of the BES-fund (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba) by raising its expenditure line from 24,903 to 24,903 thousand euros in a supplementary budget adopted alongside the Voorjaarsnota, with effect from 1 June 2012. It makes no delegation of rule-making power and includes no explanatory memorandum text.
q: Amendment of the 2012 budget statement of the BES-fund (H) (amendment linked to the Voorjaarsnota)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het BES-fonds (H) voor het jaar 2012 (wijziging samenhangend met de Voorjaarsnota)

33480-F.s: The bill amends the 2012 budget statement of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds) to reflect supplementary budget changes linked to the Najaarsnota, with amounts in thousands of euros and entry into force from 1 December 2012. It makes no delegation of rule-making power and shifts no power between executive and checks.
33480-F.j: The memorandum justifies the budget increase by extra control costs from the banned import of Turkish and Serbian straw, covering destruction costs, compensation to livestock farmers and serological testing for classical swine fever and foot-and-mouth disease.
q: Both expenditure and receipts are increased by €0.8 million for costs related to control measures following the (prohibited) import of Turkish and Serbian straw.
Zowel de uitgaven als ontvangsten worden met € 0,8 mln verhoogd voor uitgaven die samenhangen met kosten van controlemaatregelen als gevolg van de (verboden) invoer van Turks- en Servisch stro.

33640-H.s: The bill amends the 2013 budget statement of the BES-fund (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba) by adding a supplementary appropriation of 2,248 thousand euros to the expenditure side. It also sets the rounding of amounts to thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date as 1 June 2013, with retroactive effect if publication is later.
q: Article 1 The budget statement of the BES-fund for 2013 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat BES-fonds voor het jaar 2013 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33750-F.s: This bill fixes the 2014 budget statement of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds) at 10.9 million euros in expenditure, commitments and receipts for animal disease control and welfare measures. It also sets the rules for how the fund's budget is structured and when the law takes effect.
q: The budget statement attached to this law concerning the budget fund for the year 2014 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat inzake het begrotingsfonds voor het jaar 2014 wordt vastgesteld.

33930-F.s: This bill approves a supplementary budget statement (slotwet) for the Animal Health Fund for 2013, adjusting the fund's budget figures for dierziekten prevention and welfare problems. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective retroactively to the end of 2013.
q: The budget statement of the budget fund for the year 2013 is amended, as shown in the statement belonging to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het begrotingsfonds voor het jaar 2013 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34350-I.s: This bill amends the 2015 budget statement of the Royal Household (begroting van de Koning), raising appropriations by a total of 712 thousand euros through a second supplementary budget. The explanatory memorandum attributes the changes to updated constitutional allowances, a final settlement for 2014, and a wage agreement compensation.
34350-I.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to the abandonment of the public-sector wage freeze and the final settlement of prior-year accounts, without any new executive powers.
q: Partly as a result of the decision to abandon the wage freeze for civil servant salaries, an adjustment to the estimate for the constitutional allowances is taken into account.
Onder meer als gevolg van het besluit de nullijn voor de ambtenarensalarissen los te laten, wordt rekening gehouden met een aanpassing van de raming voor de grondwettelijke uitkeringen.

34350-XVIII.s: This bill amends the 2015 budget statements (begrotingsstaten) of the ministry of Housing and Central Government Affairs (XVIII) and of its baten-lastenagentschappen, via a second supplementary budget. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the changes effective from 1 December 2015, with retroactive effect where publication is late.
q: The budget statement of Housing and Central Government Affairs (XVIII) for the year 2015 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van Wonen en Rijksdienst (XVIII) voor het jaar 2015 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34475-A.s: The bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for 2015 (Slotwet), adjusting expenditure, revenue and commitment figures by article and setting the amounts in thousands of euros. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
34475-A.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by pointing to consultation with the House and to shifts in budget figures, and presents a table of budget mutations rather than justifying any delegation or new power.
q: Whereas We have considered that a change to the departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2015 has proven necessary
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2015

34485-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2016 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII), adjusting appropriations and commitments in line with the Spring Memorandum. It sets the budget amounts in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date, with retroactive effect to 1 June 2016 if publication is late.

34620-XVIII.s: This bill amends the 2016 budget statements (begrotingsstaat) of the ministry of Housing and Central Government Affairs (XVIII) and of the agencies, shifting appropriations across policy articles and agency budgets via a second supplementary budget. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and only sets the effective date and the amounts in thousands of euros.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen for an amendment of the departmental budget statement of Housing and Central Government Affairs (XVIII)
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van Wonen en Rijksdienst (XVIII)

34725-C.s: This bill amends the 2016 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) through a closing budget adjustment, setting the commitment amounts for the general grant and integration and decentralisation grants. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant is set for grant year 2016 at €229,667,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2016 vastgesteld op € 229.667.000.

34845-XVII.s: The bill amends the 2017 budget statute for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII) by adjusting appropriations across policy articles in the second supplementary budget. It also sets the commencement date of the amended statute, which takes effect 1 December with retroactive effect to 1 June in some cases.
q: The present bill aims to make changes for the year 2017 to the departmental budget statute for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII).
Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2017 wijzigingen aan te brengen in: de departementale begrotingsstaat voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking (XVII)

34950-C.s: This Slotwet amends the 2017 budget statement of the Provinciefonds, setting the 2017 commitment amounts for the general grant at EUR 2,051,405,000 and for decentralisation grants at EUR 518,160,000, with a retroactive entry into force. The bill contains no delegation of rule-making power, and no explanatory memorandum excerpt was found.
q: The 2017 budget statement of the Provinciefonds is amended as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34960-B.s: The bill amends the 2018 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) by setting new commitment amounts and increasing expenditure and receipts by about 855.9 and 877.3 million euros. It also fixes the 2018 commitment amounts for the general grant and for integration and decentralisation grants, with entry into force from 1 June 2018.
q: The 2018 budget statement of the municipal fund is amended as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35095-B.s: The bill amends the 2018 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), setting the commitment amounts for general, additional, integration and decentralisation grants for the 2018 grant year. It takes effect on 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: We ... have resolved and decided ... The budget statement of the municipal fund for 2018 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De begrotingsstaat van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2018 wordt gewijzigd

35850-C.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) by increasing the commitment amounts for the general grant and decentralisation grants. It also sets the entry-into-force date, made retroactive to 1 June 2021.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the provinciefonds for the year 2020
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2020

35925-XVII.s: This bill sets the 2022 budget for the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII), in thousands of euros, with total commitments and expenditure by policy article. It also states the effective date of 1 January 2022 and the budget's denomination in thousands of euros.
q: The budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2022 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2022 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division raised no substantive objections to the 2022 budget bill for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer, with only a drafting remark to delete the term 'departementale' since BHOS is not a separate department. The minister's nader rapport, dated 20 September 2021, announces amendments to several budgets and refers to annexes for the changes.
concerns: The advisory division asks to delete the term 'departementale' in article 1 and the budget statement because BHOS is not a separate department and has only one departmental budget statement.

36410-J.s: This bill sets the 2024 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the Delta Fund, the financing fund for flood protection and fresh water supply, with appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros. It also gives effect to the experimental article III of the Deltawet waterveiligheid en zoetwatervoorziening and the associated multi-year cash planning.
36410-J.j: The memorandum justifies the experimental article and integrated contracting as enabling integrated execution of the Delta Programme and integrated financing, without a separate justification of delegated powers.
q: The experimentation article serves the integrated implementation of the Delta Programme and allows for integrated financing.
Het experimenteerartikel staat ten dienste van een integrale uitvoering van het Deltaprogramma en biedt de mogelijkheid tot integrale bekostiging.
d: adoption of the Delta Fund budget statement

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2024 Deltafonds budget bill (voorstel van wet tot vaststelling van de begrotingsstaten van het Deltafonds voor 2024) and found no remarks. The Minister of Finance transmitted the advice together with the budget bill, which the Afdeling advised to submit to the Tweede Kamer.

36435-C.s: The bill amends the 2023 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) by adjusting commitment amounts for the general and additional grants and the integration and decentralisation grants, with effect from 19 September 2023. It is a supplementary budget bill tied to Prinsjesdag, with no delegation of rule-making power.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant and additional grants is set at €3,050,517,000 for the 2023 grant year.

Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2023 vastgesteld op € 3.050.517.000.

36600-I.s: This bill adopts the 2025 budget statement for the Crown (the Koning), setting spending and revenue for the constitutional allowances to royal family members, functional expenditure of the Crown, and charged expenditure from other budgets, in thousands of euros. It takes effect on 1 January of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Article 1 The budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2025 is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2025 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering has no remarks on the 2025 budget bill for the King (I) and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer, a blanket opinion. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport states that some budgets need amendment and refers to annexes with the proposed changes.

36625-B.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) by raising its expenditure and revenue by €134.888 million, and sets the new commitment amounts under the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general and additional grants, integration grants and decentralisation grants. It takes effect the day after publication and is retroactive to 1 December 2024.
q: Amendment of the 2024 budget statement of the municipal fund
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2024

36725-A.s: The bill amends the 2025 budget schedule (begrotingsstaat) of the Mobiliteitsfonds through a first supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across road, rail, waterway and mega-project articles. It is a technical budgetary adjustment that takes effect retroactively from 1 June 2025.
36725-A.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to timing shifts in cash needs, indexation differences and court-approved route decisions, not by any new executive power.
q: In the first supplementary budget 2025, as in previous budget documents, the expenditure estimates for all articles were critically reviewed.
Bij de eerste suppletoire begroting 2025 is er net zoals de vorige begrotingsstukken kritisch gekeken naar de uitgavenramingen op alle artikelen.

36850-B.s: The bill amends the 2025 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), setting new commitment amounts for the general grant, integration grants and decentralisation grants under the Financiële-verhoudingswet. It is a technical second supplementary budget with a retroactive effective date of 1 December 2025.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen for an amendment to the budget statement of the municipal fund for the year 2025
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2025

36850-XXII.s: The bill amends the 2025 departmental budget of the Ministry of Housing and Spatial Planning (XXII) and the budget for its agencies, in thousands of euros, through a second supplementary budget. It increases obligations and expenditure mainly for the housing market and energy transition, and makes the amendments effective from 1 December 2025.
q: Table 1 Amendment of the budget statement of the Ministry of Housing and Spatial Planning (XXII) for the year 2025 (Second supplementary budget)
Tabel 1 Wijziging begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening (XXII) voor het jaar 2025 (Tweede suppletoire begroting)
